title: ContextPack
description: A pluggable pre-dispatch context bundle assembled from sources (rg, git-log, memory, codegraph, ...). Categorical typed arrays enable per-source attribution + confidence ranking.

schema_version.description: 1 = original; 2 = adds context_hit_v1 optional fields (source_domain, why_relevant, trust_level, refs); 3 = adds the CC-505 lexical ranking fields (rank, match_kind, line_start, line_end, ranking_score, score_components). All versions are valid; a v1/v2 pack that omits the newer fields continues to validate.

name.description: Source identifier — e.g. rg, git-log, memory, codegraph. Free string; pluggable via core/context-pack/source.interface.md.

ref.description: What the item points at. File path, symbol fqn, memory slug, risk id.

source.description: Must match a sources[].name in this pack.

source_domain.description: Which index plane this item came from. 'memory' is the out-of-repo project-memory plane (cards / MEMORY.md / episodes), searched via `pmctl context --source memory`.

why_relevant.description: Human-readable explanation of why this item is relevant to the task.

trust_level.description: Reliability tier of the source that produced this item.

refs.description: Additional cross-references (e.g. related symbols, prior decisions).

rank.description: 1-based position after CC-505's shared lexical ranking pass. Distinct from `confidence` — this is a relevance ordering, not a correctness signal.

match_kind.description: Which retrieval path produced this item. like_fallback is deterministically ordered but is NOT relevance-ranked (no FTS5 available).

line_start.description: First line of the matched span, when the ref encodes one (path:line refs).

line_end.description: Last line of the matched span (bounded chunk/symbol extent).

ranking_score.description: Lexical ranking score (bm25-derived for fts5_content, tier base + boosts otherwise). Higher is more relevant WITHIN a match_kind tier. Not a correctness or confidence signal — see `confidence` for that.

score_components.description: Human-readable breakdown of ranking_score's inputs (e.g. base/bm25/trust/domain contributions), for debugging and audit — not machine-parsed.
